source: src/PboStudio.Core/Prime95Engine.cs and YCruncherEngine.cs (the markers are private there, so this is the first place they are pinned)
about: Which lines of engine output are a failure. Prime95 writes passes and failures into the same file, y-cruncher prints a settings banner containing the word Error, and the job object makes y-cruncher announce each refused processor. A pass is excluded first; only phrases that occur on failure count.

cases.name: prime95 pass in any case and spacing
a pass without a size is still a pass
